# Check memory usage and warn for large datasets

<small>Source: [`R/utils.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/utils.R) · Help: `?check_memory_usage`</small>

Check memory usage and warn for large datasets

## Usage

```r
check_memory_usage(data, threshold_mb = 100)
```

## Arguments

`data`
:   The dataset to check

`threshold_mb`
:   Memory threshold in MB (default: 100MB)
